items.title_kr: Macy's, Q2 실적 guidance 상회 전망 속 Turnaround 전략 가속화
items.title_en: Macy's Q2 earnings expected to beat guidance with turnaround strategy
items.body_kr: Macy's의 Q2 earnings가 guidance를 상회할 것으로 예상되며 시장의 관심을 모으고 있습니다. 당사 벤더들은 retail 채널의 재고 소진 속도와 Turnaround 전략에 따른 reorder 추이를 면밀히 모니터링해야 합니다.
items.body_en: Macy's Q2 earnings are expected to beat guidance, signaling momentum in its turnaround. Vendors should monitor inventory sell-through rates and potential reorder signals across retail channels.

items.title_kr: Kohl's names Walmart fashion alum as chief merchant
items.body_kr: Kohl's appointed a Walmart fashion veteran as its new chief merchant to tackle ongoing customer traffic and sales challenges. Vendors should prepare for potential shifts in merchandise strategy and category planning.

items.title_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch, 역대급 Q2 sales 기록하며 offline store Expansion 발표
items.title_en: Abercrombie & Fitch posts record Q2 sales and plans store expansion
items.body_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch delivered record Q2 sales, driving stock gains and aggressive store expansion and remodel plans. This momentum creates strong partnership opportunities for apparel vendors aligned with their growth categories.

items.title_kr: Macy's, creative 및 production 총괄하는 senior vice president 영입
items.title_en: Macy's names senior vice president of creative, production
items.body_kr: Macy's appointed a new senior vice president of creative and production to elevate its visual merchandising. Vendors should align with the new creative direction ahead of upcoming holiday promotional campaigns.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, Labor Day sale 진행하며 fall fashion merchandise 본격 판매
items.title_en: Kohl's runs Labor Day sale featuring fall fashion scores
items.body_kr: Kohl's drove customer traffic with a major Labor Day weekend sale focusing on early fall fashion merchandise. Vendor replenishment and chase strategies will depend on the sell-through results from this key promotional weekend.
